# Country State City

> An open geographical dataset of 250 countries, 5,300+ states and 150,000+ cities,
> available as a hosted REST and GraphQL API, a downloadable database in 12 formats,
> npm packages, and a browser-based export tool. The data is published under the Open
> Database License (ODbL), which permits commercial use with attribution.

Operated by dr5hn. The dataset is the one behind the
countries-states-cities-database repository on GitHub.

## Key facts

- Base URL: https://api.countrystatecity.in/v1
- Authentication: an API key in the `X-CSCAPI-KEY` request header
- Free tier: 3,000 requests a month, no card required
- Paid plans start at $5 a month
- Data licence: Open Database License (ODbL), attribution required
- Source repository: https://github.com/dr5hn/countries-states-cities-database

## APIs

- [Country API](https://countrystatecity.in/country-api/): 250 countries and territories with ISO 3166-1 codes, dial codes, currencies, capitals, regions and coordinates.
- [State API](https://countrystatecity.in/state-api/): 5,300+ states and provinces with ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes, each linked to its country.
- [City API](https://countrystatecity.in/city-api/): 150,000+ cities, each with latitude, longitude, and its state and country.
- [API overview and plans](https://countrystatecity.in/product/api/): rate limits, field filtering, fuzzy search, GraphQL and the change feed.

## Other ways to get the data

- [Offline database](https://countrystatecity.in/product/database/): the same dataset as SQL, JSON, CSV, XML, YAML and more, 12 formats in all.
- [npm packages](https://countrystatecity.in/npm-packages/): nine packages under the `@countrystatecity` scope for bundling the data with an application, no network call at runtime.
- [Export tool](https://countrystatecity.in/product/export-tool/): pick fields and filters in the browser and download a custom extract.
- [Update tool](https://countrystatecity.in/product/update-tool/): submit corrections to the dataset.
